name: zvideo_run_postprocess_on_sw_buffer
description: zVideo::RunPostprocessOnSwBuffer locks the software surface state, binds it as the renderer framebuffer and zVideo FX surface, then queues the pass-3 primitive over that surface.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4a6770 calls g_zVideo_pfnLockSurfaceState with &g_zVideo_SwSurfaceState, then zRndr::SetFrameBufferRegion with pixels/null/0/pitch, zVideo::Fx_SetSurfaceState with pixels/width/height/pitch, and zVideo::FxPass3_QueuePrimitive with the same surface tuple.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a6770 has no warnings or tags; its direct callees are functionally accepted.

The native smoke replaces the lock-surface callback, seeds g_zVideo_SwSurfaceState, calls zVideo::RunPostprocessOnSwBuffer, and verifies the lock callback target, zRndr framebuffer globals, zVideo FX surface globals, and pass-3 primitive configuration fields.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4a6770 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
